description: This file implements the SystemTime class, which manages system time synchronization, timezone handling, and event subscriptions via JSON-RPC in a plugin environment. It includes methods for updating time status, timezone info, and handling events related to time changes.

classes.name: SystemTime
classes.description: A class that manages system time synchronization, timezone information, and event handling within a plugin framework.

methods.name: SystemTime::SystemTime
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SystemTime object, starting the event loop thread, and pushing an initialization event.

methods.name: SystemTime::~SystemTime
methods.description: Destructor that signals shutdown, joins the event thread, and unsubscribes from events.

methods.name: SystemTime::IsSystemTimeAvailable
methods.description: Returns whether the system time is currently available.

methods.name: SystemTime::GetTimeZoneOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the current timezone offset in seconds and its accuracy.

methods.name: SystemTime::onTimeStatusChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when the system time status changes, enqueues the event for processing.

methods.name: SystemTime::onTimeZoneDSTChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when the timezone or DST status changes, enqueues the event.

methods.name: SystemTime::CreateSystemLink
methods.description: Establishes a JSON-RPC link to the system service, including security token generation.

methods.name: SystemTime::SubscribeForEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to system time and timezone change events via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: SystemTime::UpdateTimeStatus
methods.description: Queries the current time status from the system service and updates internal state.

methods.name: SystemTime::UpdateTimeZone
methods.description: Queries the current timezone and accuracy, updating internal state and transition map.

methods.name: SystemTime::ParseTimeZone
methods.description: Parses the timezone and accuracy string to determine timezone offset and accuracy.

methods.name: SystemTime::PopulateTimeZoneTransitionMap
methods.description: Populates the timezone transition map by parsing the output of 'zdump' for the current timezone.

methods.name: SystemTime::EventLoop
methods.description: Main event loop processing queued events such as initialization, time status updates, timezone updates, and shutdown.
